tools.name: review.get_state
tools.title: Review State
tools.description: Read the current gated-review state for a review thread.

tools.name: review.list_actions
tools.title: Review Actions
tools.description: List curated actions that have been taken for a review thread.

tools.name: open_pr
tools.title: Open Pull Request
tools.description: Open a pull request. Requires repository as an owner/name slug.

tools.name: set_pr_draft
tools.title: Set Pull Request Draft
tools.description: Mark a pull request ready for review (draft: false) or convert it to a draft (draft: true). Succeeds without change when the pull request is already in that state. Requires repository as an owner/name slug.

tools.name: reply_to_thread
tools.title: Reply To Thread
tools.description: Reply to a GitHub review thread. Requires repository as an owner/name slug.

tools.name: resolve_thread
tools.title: Resolve Thread
tools.description: Resolve a review thread once you have actually handled it (fix pushed, or operator-approved ignore). Unresolved threads are the agent inbox; resolving is how a handled thread leaves it. Requires repository as an owner/name slug.

tools.name: request_next_round
tools.title: Request Next Round
tools.description: Request another Copilot review round on a pull request. Requires repository as an owner/name slug.

tools.name: git.push
tools.title: Git Push
tools.description: Push a branch to origin through the server (remote credentials stay server-side). Do NOT use git push/pull/fetch in the shell or GitHub CLI (gh) for remote operations. Requires repository as an owner/name slug.

tools.name: git.pull
tools.title: Git Pull
tools.description: Pull a branch from origin through the server (remote credentials stay server-side). Do NOT use git push/pull/fetch in the shell or GitHub CLI (gh) for remote operations. Requires repository as an owner/name slug.

tools.name: git.fetch
tools.title: Git Fetch
tools.description: Fetch a refspec from origin through the server (remote credentials stay server-side). Do NOT use git push/pull/fetch in the shell or GitHub CLI (gh) for remote operations. Requires repository as an owner/name slug.

tools.name: get_review_round
tools.title: Review Round
tools.description: Read all open review threads with their complete comment history; include resolved threads with includeResolved: true. Freshness only annotates threads and never hides previously fetched threads or comments. Returns the required triage prompt for grouping comments into fix, discuss, or ignore. Requires repository as an owner/name slug.

includeResolved.description: Also return resolved threads with their complete comment history. Previously fetched threads and comments are always returned.

tools.name: pr_status
tools.title: PR Status
tools.description: Read advisory status for a pull request. Requires repository as an owner/name slug.

tools.name: get_workflow_status
tools.title: Workflow Status
tools.description: Read the latest GitHub Actions workflow runs for the PR head and test merge commits. Returns status, conclusion, failed jobs, and log tails (up to 20,000 characters per job, 10 job downloads per response), with explicit unavailable and truncated results. Requires repository as an owner/name slug.

assertions.name: sessions_receive_this_endpoint_unfiltered
assertions.detail: selectMcpServers supplies the configured URL unchanged, with no header
